description: Search people mentioned in the BORME by name (usually as officers: administrators, attorneys, auditors). Returns name mentions with `slug`, number of mentions and companies, and first/last seen. These are NOT identity profiles: two people with the same name share one slug. Use the slug with borme_get_person.

q.description: Person name as written in the BORME, e.g. "Garcia Lopez Eduardo". Results are unresolved name mentions (homonyms are possible), not identity profiles.

name: borme_search_persons
